title: OperatorResult
description: Final result of one Mac operator run (claude -p + mac broker). Mirrors the broker's finish() call.

status.description: done = goal reached and verified by an observation taken after the last action; failed = could not do it; unknown_partial = some actions ran but the end state is unverified; needs_confirmation = the broker blocked a risky call.

summary.description: One or two short sentences for the user, suitable to be spoken.

evidence_obs_id.description: obs_id of the observe_screen call that proves the end state, or null.
